verdicts.detail: All named tools exist in the editToolPanel (Move NoGaps 861, Slide KeepGaps 862, R Cons 867, Ins/Del Gap Seq/Other/All 869-874, Type 876, Select Col 877, Clear Gap Cols 879, SeqEdit 880). MISMATCH on the Type detail: the claim says it accepts 'a residue letter (A, C, G, T, N) or - for a gap', but handleGeneDocResidueKey accepts ANY letter. Line 19541 regex is /^[A-Za-z.-]$/ (any A-Z/a-z letter plus '.' and '-'), and line 19553 does `chars[pos] = (e.key === '.' || e.key === '-') ? GENEDOC_FILLER : e.key.toUpperCase();` with GENEDOC_FILLER='-' (line 18465). So the code accepts all 26 letters (uppercased), not just A,C,G,T,N, and accepts both '.' and '-' as gaps (claim names only '-').
